thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Gets a Hold Rating from Maxim Group

author: Catie Powers
title: Apple (AAPL) Gets a Hold Rating from Maxim Group
text:
Catie Powers 51 AM EDT SHARE ON:
In a report released today, Nehal Chokshi from Maxim Group maintained a Hold rating on Apple ( AAPL ), with a price target of $160 . $157.92, close to its 52-week low of $146.59.
Chokshi observed:
“December quarter negative pre-announcement detail implies China iPhone revenue down at least 35% y/y. Magnitude of China iPhone miss unlikely purely attributable to a weak China smartphone market, leading us to assume an iPhone installed base haircut is forthcoming. There is risk of more than one year before AAPL revenue stabilizes, in our view; cutting estimates and PT multiple to 13x (from 15x), resulting in 12- month PT reduction to $160, from $212.”
 Chokshi is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 8.1% and a 53.9% success rate. Chokshi covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Super Micro Computer, and Palo Alto Networks.
The word on The Street in general, suggests a Moderate Buy analyst consensus rating for Apple with a $203.83 average price target, which is a 29.1% upside from current levels. In a report released today, New Street also upgraded the stock to Hold.
.
Based on Apple’s latest earnings release for the quarter ending September 30, the company reported a quarterly revenue of $62.68 billion and net profit of $14.13 billion. In comparison, last year the company earned revenue of $88.48 billion and had a net profit of $20.07 billion.
